title: adenandra marginata subsp. humilis
intro: Adenandra marginata subsp. humilis, commonly known as the Cape jasmine or Cape gardenia, is a flowering plant species within the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its fragrance, medicinal, and ornamental properties. The health benefits of Adenandra marginata subsp. humilis include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can help alleviate various health issues such as infections and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antiseptic, antispasmodic, and antifungal properties, while its bioactive constituents include limonene, pinene, and other volatile compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
